title: Install and launch
steps: Download DMG; move app to Applications; launch.
outcome: Menu bar app available.
gaps: Gatekeeper instructions may reflect older builds; hardware performance untested.

title: Complete setup and download models
steps: Grant required permissions; await models; practice or skip.
outcome: Setup reaches the menu bar.
gaps: Download resume, proxy behavior, disk exhaustion and cancellation unverified.

title: Choose and test a microphone
steps: Choose or rescan microphone; start and stop test.
outcome: Sample transcript or error.
gaps: Bluetooth reconnect and device removal behavior untested.

title: Dictate with hold or toggle
steps: Use configured hold chord or toggle chord; speak; finish.
outcome: Dictation proceeds to transcription and insertion.
gaps: README and release-source defaults conflict; cancellation UX incomplete.

title: Insert text or recover through clipboard
steps: Finish dictation; allow automatic insertion or paste clipboard manually.
outcome: Text inserted or retained on clipboard.
gaps: Secure fields, browser editors and focus races untested.

title: Clean dictated text and customize corrections
steps: Enable cleanup; optionally edit prompt and correction hints.
outcome: Locally revised dictation.
gaps: Accuracy and hallucination rates unknown; detailed context learning untested.

title: Choose, download and remove models
steps: Select model; await readiness; remove eligible unused models.
outcome: Selected model ready or a loading state.
gaps: Memory requirements and download recovery not comprehensively documented.

title: Dictate in another language
steps: Choose compatible multilingual model and language; dictate.
outcome: Speech recognition uses selected model/language.
gaps: Translation and mixed-language guarantees absent.

title: Recover from permission or input errors
steps: Open indicated permission settings; retry or reload input.
outcome: A route back to recording readiness.
gaps: Recovery success and error completeness unverified.

title: Keep, revisit or delete dictation history
steps: Opt into History; inspect/search; delete entries or clear.
outcome: Saved dictation can be revisited or removed.
gaps: Retention duration and deletion of every related artifact unverified.

title: Detect a meeting and accept transcription
steps: Enable detection; enter supported call; accept offered recording.
outcome: A meeting recording can start.
gaps: False positives and exact browser coverage untested.

title: Start an ad hoc recording with participant notice
steps: Open workspace; create ad hoc meeting; confirm or cancel notice.
outcome: Recording starts or remains pending.
gaps: No pause/resume flow established; notice wording not legal guidance.

title: Capture microphone and system audio, then stop
steps: Record local and system audio; stop; await finalization.
outcome: A finalized meeting transcript is saved.
gaps: Save errors are logged in inspected source; visible recovery not established.

title: Identify attendees and speakers
steps: Detect attendee names; review recognized speakers.
outcome: Named participants and reusable voice identities.
gaps: Speaker accuracy, duplicate identities and profile deletion coverage incomplete.

title: Generate and customize a meeting summary
steps: Open Summary; customize if needed; generate or regenerate.
outcome: Local summary associated with meeting.
gaps: Model context limits and recovery behavior unverified.

title: Take meeting notes or create a personal note
steps: Edit meeting Notes or create personal note with Command-N.
outcome: Authored note in the workspace.
gaps: Autosave timing and editor semantics incompletely documented.

title: Browse and search the library
steps: Filter sidebar, search tab or use Command-K; open result.
outcome: Relevant stored item opens.
gaps: Scale, indexing lag and search completeness unknown.

title: Use Markdown outside the app
steps: Locate saved Markdown; open or copy it externally.
outcome: Portable local meeting document.
gaps: External-edit conflict resolution and export format guarantees unknown.

title: Import previous Granola meetings
steps: Enter Granola API key; fetch; inspect completion or error.
outcome: Imported meetings appear locally.
gaps: API entitlement, deduplication and schema changes untested.

title: Connect calendar and start from an event
steps: Connect supported Google Calendar build; select event.
outcome: Calendar context can seed a meeting.
gaps: OAuth rollout, invite requirements and offline freshness uncertain.

title: Ask questions across meeting knowledge
steps: Prepare local model; ask question; continue conversation.
outcome: Locally generated response or missing-model error.
gaps: Historical cloud documentation conflicts; runtime network audit absent.

title: Build indexes, dossiers and derived knowledge
steps: Build index; inspect dossier; review changes before applying.
outcome: Derived knowledge pages linked to meeting material.
gaps: Generation backend varies by route; full review/rollback flow unresolved.

title: Bundle voice and screen context
steps: Capture voice/context; review; choose copy or configured cloud action.
outcome: Reusable bundle, cloud response or note.
gaps: Exact transmitted payload and integration failures not audited.

title: Work offline and understand privacy boundaries
steps: Prepare models; use local core; leave cloud integrations unused.
outcome: Documented local processing and storage.
gaps: No runtime network capture; external folder sync remains outside app claims.

title: Update, launch at login and quit
steps: Check/install update; configure login; quit when needed.
outcome: Updated or stopped menu bar app.
gaps: Rollback and retained-data migration unverified.

title: Invoke external automation
steps: No documented external automation path recovered.
outcome: Unknown.
gaps: Shortcuts, AppleScript, URL schemes, CLI and watch-folder support unverified.

title: Install and authorize
steps: First use: install, open, sign in, grant microphone/system-audio permissions on Mac, then run the demonstration meeting.
outcome: Home contains the tutorial note.
gaps: Mac requires 14+; denial recovery needs device testing.

title: Sign in or switch identity
steps: Choose Google, Microsoft or Enterprise SSO; complete browser authentication and calendar consent; return to Granola. Sign out in Settings to change accounts.
outcome: Account and calendar are linked.
gaps: Cloud Microsoft 365 only; organizational approval may block entry.

title: Select calendars
steps: With a connected provider, open Calendar settings and enable additional calendars; share external calendars into that provider with event-detail access.
outcome: Coming up reflects eligible events.
gaps: No Apple Calendar; declined/focus/out-of-office entries are excluded.

title: Respond to meeting prompts
steps: For a calendar meeting or detected call, open Granola's prompt to launch the call/note; adjust all-app or per-app notifications in Settings.
outcome: Capture begins from a deliberate prompt interaction.
gaps: Calendar prompts require multiple attendees; popups are Granola windows.

title: Prepare with briefs
steps: Open an upcoming external meeting's note and expand its brief; optionally connect Gmail for prior email context.
outcome: Preparation combines meeting history, calendar and external sources.
gaps: Google Calendar required; sparse context or internal meetings yield no brief.

title: Start scheduled or ad-hoc capture
steps: Open a started calendar meeting or New Note. Opening an upcoming note schedules transcription to begin at its start time.
outcome: Microphone and system audio feed a note.
gaps: Merely running Granola does not capture; web cannot transcribe.

title: Inspect and control live capture
steps: Open waveform panel; inspect live channels, search/copy/delete transcript chunks, and Stop/Resume. Use the floating indicator to return to the note.
outcome: Capture state and textual evidence stay inspectable.
gaps: Sleep, silence or call-end detection can stop capture.

title: Steer the summary with raw notes
steps: During a meeting, type optional headings, bullets, checkboxes and emphasis; paste or drop JPEG/PNG images.
outcome: Manual context guides enhancement.
gaps: Blank raw notes are allowed; image accessibility untested.

title: Name speakers
steps: Configure supported Meet/Zoom/Teams speaker tags using the documented extension or accessibility route, then transcribe and inspect names.
outcome: Transcript segments gain participant display names.
gaps: No historical relabeling; shared-room devices and overlapping speech remain ambiguous.

title: Capture presentation snapshots
steps: Enable shared-screen snapshots, authorize Accessibility and Screen Recording, then inspect/remove images from the Images stack.
outcome: Presented content joins note context.
gaps: Supported apps only; hidden windows pause capture; own shares excluded.

title: Finish and enhance
steps: End transcription manually or let detected call completion trigger enhancement from transcript, raw notes and calendar context.
outcome: Structured notes appear automatically.
gaps: Latency and failure recovery require observation.

title: Inspect summary evidence
steps: After enhancement, use the magnifying-glass control beside a point to inspect its raw-note or transcript origin.
outcome: A claim can be checked against captured text.
gaps: No retained-audio playback established.

title: Correct or regenerate
steps: Edit enhanced text directly, or edit raw notes and regenerate; select another template or ask Chat to rewrite.
outcome: The current meeting's output changes.
gaps: Edits do not train future note style; version rollback unknown.

title: Create, apply and share templates
steps: Select a template from the note/menu; author structure and instructions in Manage templates; optionally share with the organization.
outcome: Notes regenerate into the chosen format.
gaps: Company-domain sharing; focused guide and feature-request page conflict on preselection.

title: Choose transcription/summary language
steps: Set English or multilingual transcription and English/Auto summary language; regenerate existing summaries if needed.
outcome: Language behavior matches selected preferences.
gaps: Mobile selects one language; old transcripts cannot be re-transcribed by changing settings.

title: Personalize profile and release channel
steps: Add professional context in Profile; opt into or leave the beta channel through Preferences/Labs.
outcome: Summary guidance and update channel change.
gaps: Effect on note quality and rollout timing unmeasured.

title: Teach vocabulary
steps: Enter personal terms in Language, or add shared workspace jargon as admin.
outcome: Recognition receives personal and team vocabulary.
gaps: 30 personal/50 workspace terms; no deterministic word substitution.

title: Chat about one or many meetings
steps: Ask from a note, home, folder or selected meetings; attach extra files on desktop; use explicit rewrite prompts to edit notes.
outcome: Answers or edits use the selected context.
gaps: Basic history is 30 days; no iPad/Android Chat; threads remain private.

title: Check Chat's citations
steps: Ask across personal/shared/team notes, inspect inline citations and redirect the referenced note set when needed.
outcome: Answer provenance is exposed for review.
gaps: Citation completeness and factual accuracy not tested.

title: Dictate a Chat question
steps: Click the Chat microphone, speak a short question, then checkmark to submit or X to cancel.
outcome: Speech becomes a Chat request.
gaps: This does not start meeting capture or type into other apps.

title: Save and reuse recipes
steps: Create a named prompt, choose single- or multiple-meeting context, save, then invoke via slash menu; share or remix others' recipes.
outcome: Repeatable prompts run on selected meeting context.
gaps: Static prompts lack variables; one context type per recipe.

title: Review suggested follow-up email
steps: Connect same-account Gmail with read/send permissions; open a suggested external-meeting draft, edit and send; use brief Undo if necessary.
outcome: A reviewed follow-up is sent.
gaps: At most 10 attendees; device-local edits and unsaved attachments; Outlook unsupported.

title: Act through connected Chat
steps: Connect Gmail, Slack or Google Calendar; request an action, review/edit its destination and content, then Send/Create event or dismiss.
outcome: Email, Slack message or calendar event is created.
gaps: Google-only email/calendar; calendar domain limits; interrupted drafts require retry.

title: Find people, companies and old notes
steps: Search the automatic People/Companies directory, open a record and inspect/chat with associated notes; use note search for history.
outcome: Related conversations become navigable.
gaps: Calendar attendance seeds directories; no manual additions; offline search is release-documented.

title: Organize folders and recurring meetings
steps: Create a folder in a space; add selected notes; nest owned folders one level; accept recurring-series auto-add when offered.
outcome: Notes form reusable collections.
gaps: Multiple-folder membership; removing recurring membership cancels its rule.

title: Share a collection
steps: In folder settings choose space, members and link access; invite recipients to use the collection.
outcome: Authorized people access the collection.
gaps: Web omits full transcripts; folder roles and note-edit roles differ.

title: Share or request a single note
steps: After enhancement, invite/copy link, assign Viewer or Collaborator; a blocked recipient can Request access for owner approval.
outcome: Recipient can read, chat or edit as permitted.
gaps: Sharing creates no workspace seat; exact transcript-role boundaries need verification.

title: Set sharing defaults and ceilings
steps: Set future-note default visibility, adjust an individual note, or enforce workspace sharing restrictions and approved domains.
outcome: Link exposure follows the applicable policy.
gaps: User defaults are prospective; enterprise restrictions apply retroactively; iPhone links can still be unusable.

title: Discover shared notes and notify teammates
steps: Open Shared with me to find received notes; type an @mention in a note and optionally email its link.
outcome: Shared context reaches relevant teammates.
gaps: Mention-notification permission semantics and current UI require verification.

title: Manage workspace membership
steps: Create/join/switch workspaces; invite members, assign roles, remove members, or leave after moving needed notes.
outcome: Personal and team contexts remain separate.
gaps: Removal revokes access; paid joins add seats; last-admin and deletion prerequisites apply.

title: Provision organizational identity
steps: Configure SSO, test sign-in and optionally enforce it; connect SCIM and assign users/groups in the identity provider.
outcome: Identity provisioning governs workspace membership.
gaps: Company domain and 50-seat minimum; directory-owned users cannot be removed manually.

title: Grant access through groups
steps: Create a manual group or sync one through SCIM, then grant it Space/folder Viewer or Collaborator access.
outcome: Membership changes update permissions.
gaps: Synced groups are edited at the identity provider.

title: Send a note to Notion
steps: Connect Notion using its developer-provided database template; after enhancement, send a note from its menu.
outcome: A page appears in the dedicated database.
gaps: No native bulk/automatic sync or arbitrary destination; reauthorization handles permission errors.

title: Post notes to Slack
steps: Connect matching Slack identity; choose a channel for one note or configure future folder additions to auto-post.
outcome: Slack receives link and summary.
gaps: Private channels need app access; later Granola restriction does not retract posted text.

title: Automate through Zapier
steps: Choose manual-share or future-folder-add trigger, select workspace, test sample notes and configure downstream actions.
outcome: Meeting data drives the Zap.
gaps: Payload includes raw notes and full transcript; no retroactive folder trigger.

title: Sync HubSpot records
steps: Authorize HubSpot, choose Meeting/Note entity type, then select contact/company/deal or configure folder matching.
outcome: Summary attaches to selected/matching CRM records.
gaps: No matching attendee email means no auto-created data; inspect last-sync error.

title: Sync Attio records
steps: Connect Attio; review suggested people/company records for one note, or configure matching future folder additions.
outcome: CRM receives a note on matching records.
gaps: Existing folder contents do not backfill; unmatched emails produce no record.

title: Send to Affinity
steps: Generate a personal Affinity key, connect it in Granola, review suggested/search additional records and save.
outcome: New notes attach to chosen CRM records.
gaps: Per-user key; existing CRM notes are not edited or deleted.

title: Connect an external AI through MCP
steps: Authorize via browser OAuth or enterprise-managed authorization, select active workspace and query authorized notes.
outcome: External assistants retrieve meeting context.
gaps: Basic recent personal scope; paid shared/public access; enterprise transcript controls apply.

title: Create a scoped API key
steps: Open Connectors/API keys, choose personal/public note scopes, generate and copy a key for an integration.
outcome: Programmatic access follows selected scopes.
gaps: Admin policy may disable scopes; no API exercise performed.

title: Capture an in-person mobile meeting
steps: Start a meeting/New Note, inspect timer/bars, pause/resume and End; after processing open/share its transcript.
outcome: Mobile microphone conversation becomes enhanced notes.
gaps: No other-app call audio; Bluetooth may select the wrong microphone.

title: Capture an outbound phone call
steps: Open dialer, verify your number by call/code, optionally grant contacts, dial a contact/number and end normally.
outcome: Call summary arrives after processing.
gaps: No inbound capture; one account per number; regional and carrier restrictions.

title: Record from Apple Watch
steps: Install companion/complication, start a meeting or new recording and End; monitor saved/sync/upload/generation states.
outcome: Watch audio becomes phone/desktop notes.
gaps: Offline recording works; mandatory chime; retry partial sync, but interrupted capture cannot resume.

title: Continue mobile notes on desktop
steps: Finish mobile transcription and summary; open the completed note on desktop for templates, integrations and editing.
outcome: Notes, transcripts and later edits synchronize.
gaps: In-progress/pre-meeting mobile notes do not sync; wait for processing.

title: Export owned history
steps: In Profile choose Generate CSV and workspaces; open emailed download while signed into the requesting account.
outcome: CSV contains owned summarized notes and transcripts, including older Basic history.
gaps: 24-hour link/request limits; excludes deleted or unsummarized notes; no admin-wide export.

title: Delete and restore notes
steps: Move a note to trash; restore from trash or permanently delete.
outcome: Accidental deletion remains recoverable before expiry.
gaps: Trash expires after 30 days; iPhone restoration requires another supported app.

title: Set transcript retention
steps: Select a retention period and confirm; individuals receive a week cooldown, enterprise activation can delete old transcripts immediately.
outcome: Transcripts expire while notes remain.
gaps: Irreversible; regeneration stops and Chat loses transcript detail.

title: Opt out of model improvement
steps: Disable the model-improvement setting; Enterprise enforces organization-level policy.
outcome: Future training use follows the opt-out.
gaps: Vendor says providers cannot train; prior anonymized use remains unverified; no BYO models.

title: Move between workspaces
steps: Choose a member destination, inspect bulk-transfer preview and confirm; use per-note Move for a subset.
outcome: Notes change workspace with eligible private folders.
gaps: Admin controls may hide transfer; shared folders, templates and billing differ.

title: Move from another Granola account
steps: From destination Profile start import, enter source email and verify its code.
outcome: Notes/transcripts move rather than copy.
gaps: Old-email access and source-policy permission required; no third-party import; billing stays behind.

title: Upgrade and manage billing
steps: Select Business/Enterprise upgrade, complete checkout or share checkout link; manage invoices/payment details in the portal.
outcome: Workspace entitlement and active-seat billing update.
gaps: Basic is free, Business $14, Enterprise from $35 per user/month; no mixed tier within workspace.

title: Cancel a subscription
steps: Open billing management and cancel; retain paid access through the current billing period.
outcome: Workspace returns to Basic.
gaps: Older notes remain stored but become inaccessible in-app; charges belong to each workspace.

title: Delete account or workspace
steps: Export/transfer wanted content; use account deletion or satisfy workspace deletion prerequisites and confirm.
outcome: Owned content is permanently removed.
gaps: Shared folder containers may survive account deletion; transferred ownership survives; legal-hold interaction unverified.

title: Repair missing audio
steps: Inspect microphone/system channels, Stop/Resume, select the correct mic, verify OS permissions and run network check.
outcome: Capture fault narrows to routing, permissions or connectivity.
gaps: Live transcription requires network; VDI and Bluetooth introduce documented limits.

title: Recover failed or missing notes
steps: Retry/regenerate when a transcript exists; otherwise check account, workspace, membership and whether capture started.
outcome: Existing data is found or generation retried.
gaps: Uncaptured audio is unrecoverable; exact interruption/offline recovery remains untested.

title: Disclose active transcription
platform: Desktop; Free / Business or Enterprise policy
steps: In Transparency preferences enable automated meeting-chat notice, or install/select Granola Watermark camera in the meeting app.
outcome: Participants receive a visible transcription signal.
gaps: Meet uses an extension; Slack huddles require Mac Accessibility; notice delivery and consent are not verified.

title: Install and authorize Mac
steps: Trigger/preconditions: First installation; an account and microphone are needed. Path: Download, move to Applications, open and sign in. Grant Microphone and Accessibility. Optional Screen Recording enables richer context; restart after permission changes. Try the selected shortcut in an editable field.
outcome: A recording starts and text can be inserted.
gaps: Exact onboarding screens and minimum macOS version remain unverified.

title: Manage account identity and recovery
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A new device, missing entitlement, lost login, or account change. Path: Reuse the original email/Google/Apple/Every login; check account email and plan. Recover through that provider. Mac email changes require a code; active Every Bundle blocks self-service. iOS offers Delete Account; Mac deletion uses support.
outcome: Access restored or account changed/deleted.
gaps: Apple relay identities can split accounts; deletion is permanent. iOS email-change availability has conflicting evidence.

title: Dictate and control recording
steps: Trigger/preconditions: An editable field has focus and recording permissions are granted. Path: On Mac hold right Option and release, or use a separate hands-free toggle. Cancel discards insertion. Settings records keyboard or supported mouse bindings; right Shift opens modes. On mobile tap the keyboard microphone, speak, then stop.
outcome: Cleaned text appears at the cursor.
gaps: Keep the destination focused; shortcut conflicts need separate testing. Exact supported mouse buttons are unspecified.

title: Choose input and media behavior
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Changing microphones or controlling other audio. Path: In Mic & Audio choose automatic selection or order preferred inputs; check the live meter. Configure sounds and keep/mute/pause media, including per-output choices. Mobile Preferences can prefer the built-in microphone.
outcome: Expected input and audio behavior selected.
gaps: Bluetooth activation can clip starts or reduce playback quality; reconnect or test built-in input.

title: Choose language and local processing
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Dictating multilingual speech or needing offline transcription. Path: Choose Auto Detect or up to three languages. On Apple-silicon Mac choose Local under Transcription source, download, and wait for installed status; the same control removes the model.
outcome: Raw local transcription works offline; remote service provides smart formatting.
gaps: Local accuracy may differ. Mobile local processing, arbitrary model endpoints, and complete offline cleanup are not documented.

title: Configure style and app/site activation
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A recurring writing task needs consistent output. Path: Select or edit a mode. On Mac assign apps or domains and optionally Override default. Configure Auto enter with the target send key. Blazing Fast bypasses usual cleanup and can have separate activations.
outcome: The active mode shapes dictation and may submit it.
gaps: Conflicting activation precedence is incomplete; Auto enter can submit before review. Blazing Fast preserves rough speech.

title: Teach and import vocabulary
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Names or technical words transcribe incorrectly. Path: Open Dictionary, add exact spelling and optional spoken-to-written replacement. Import through the source-app prompts for Aqua Voice, Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, or Willow Voice. Correct duplicate/conflicting entries and retry.
outcome: Personal vocabulary informs future dictation.
gaps: Import merge rules, bulk export, and correction-learning mechanics are unspecified.

title: Set regional English spelling
steps: Trigger/preconditions: English transcription needs British or Australian conventions. Path: Keep English as the recording language; add the regional preference in Dictation Instructions. Repeat it in overriding modes when necessary; use Dictionary for individual spellings.
outcome: Normal dictations follow the requested convention.
gaps: No separate British/Australian recording-language choice; wrong results can be reported from the affected item.

title: Enable contextual dictation
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Relevant screen text may improve names or references. Path: Enable Deep context in Data & Privacy and grant screen-capture permission. Dictate with relevant material visible; optional access can be revoked through macOS settings.
outcome: Supported on-screen content informs the result.
gaps: Exact capture region, exclusion rules, and behavior for inaccessible windows are undocumented. Coding accuracy examples remain marketing claims.

title: Recover a dictation or failed paste
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Text missed its destination or an earlier result is needed. Path: Open History; copy, replay available audio, retry a recoverable failure, delete, reveal an available file, or send feedback. Paste last transcript inserts again while preserving prior clipboard contents. Copied/App changed permits manual paste.
outcome: A usable transcript can be recovered.
gaps: History retention duration is unknown. Home/Dictations labels differ by source; secure fields can block insertion.

title: Set indicator and background behavior
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Choosing recording visibility or system integration. Path: Settings exposes recording indicators, idle/per-app visibility, launch at login, Dock presence, prevent-sleep behavior, attribution, and compatibility insertion. Newer releases add Dot near the writing field.
outcome: Recording state remains visible in the preferred form.
gaps: Guide says Mini; newer release says Dot. Their exact relationship and app-switch paste behavior require runtime inspection.

title: Install and use the mobile keyboard
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Monologue onboarding is complete. Path: In system Keyboard settings add Monologue and enable Full Access; allow Microphone in the app. Switch via the globe key, record, and stop to insert. Keyboard settings configure typing feedback and correction behavior.
outcome: Dictation works within supported host text fields.
gaps: Password/payment fields can force Apple's keyboard; Full Access is required for cross-app dictation.

title: Reactivate the mobile microphone session
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Keyboard shows Start Monologue or stops responding. Path: Start Monologue opens the main app to activate its microphone session, then attempts to return. Switch back manually if needed. Reopen after force-quit; restore permissions or try Built-in Microphone when levels stay flat.
outcome: The keyboard can record again.
gaps: Timeout, calls, interruptions, and route changes can end the session; automatic return is not guaranteed.

title: Tune mobile modes and activity status
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Changing dictation behavior outside the main app. Path: Preferences selects languages, quiet-recording timeout, microphone, audio behavior, sounds, and haptics. Dictation Instructions edits modes; Blazing Fast skips usual instructions. Enable Live Activities for keyboard dictation or Notes.
outcome: Recording progress appears on Lock Screen or supported Dynamic Island.
gaps: Quick Dictation ignores Pause Other Audio. Available timeout values are not listed.

title: Use Action Button or Shortcuts
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Keyboard, microphone, and Live Activities are configured. Path: Use Monologue's guided Action Button setup to add Dictation to Clipboard, then assign it in iOS. Hold to start and again to finish; selected Monologue keyboard enables cursor insertion. Shortcuts offers dictation modes and Record Note.
outcome: Hardware or automation starts voice capture.
gaps: Replacing an existing Action Button assignment changes its prior behavior; shortcut options vary by action.

title: Capture a note or meeting
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A longer recording should become a saved Note. Path: Open Notes or its shortcut; record, pause/resume, stop and upload. Mac sources include microphone and optional system audio; denied screen permission leaves microphone-only capture. Meeting detection can offer start/end reminders. Mac limits offer 30m/1h/2h/3h/4h/6h, with warning before auto-save.
outcome: A saved recording enters processing.
gaps: Meeting detection does not establish automatic recording. Its supported-app list and non-Mac duration limits are unspecified.

title: Recover and retry saved recordings
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A recording is interrupted or processing stalls. Path: Reopen and follow available recovery prompts; check duration and let upload finish. Notes distinguish Uploading, Processing, Completed, and error/retry states. When stuck, reconnect, retry from the note, then report that item.
outcome: Recovered audio can proceed to transcript and summary.
gaps: Recovery is conditional, not a lossless guarantee. Do not remove pending local audio; mobile recovery export is separately advertised.

title: Refine a completed note
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A processed Note is available. Path: Edit title/summary; listen alongside the transcript, name speakers, and mark yourself. Regenerate the summary after speaker changes. About Me supplies context for future summaries and allows up to 10,000 characters.
outcome: A clearer saved record and personalized future summaries.
gaps: Regeneration overwrites manual summary edits. Editing availability varies by device; transcript-text editing is not established.

title: Organize with tags
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A user wants reusable note categories. Path: Create tags before recording. Processing may assign one existing tag from title/summary matching; otherwise leaves the note untagged. Add, replace, remove, rename, or delete tags manually.
outcome: Notes can be categorized and filtered.
gaps: Automatic tagging never creates categories; dictation mode instructions do not control tag selection.

title: Find and review Notes on the web
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A native recording has uploaded to the account. Path: Open Notes, search title/content, filter tags, and paginate older results. Inspect summary, speaker transcript, available recording, status, tags, duration, and date. If missing, finish device upload and refresh.
outcome: Synced recordings are reviewable in a browser.
gaps: The web app does not record new Notes. Offline browser access is undocumented.

title: Edit, share, revoke, and save shared Notes
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A completed Note or received public link exists. Path: Web title/summary changes autosave. Copy text/Markdown or speaker transcript; create a link after processing. Recipients can read without accounts or sign in to Save to Monologue. Turn off sharing to revoke access.
outcome: Shared with me retains read-only access and is available through MCP.
gaps: Saving preserves a reference, not a copy; owner revocation still applies. Deletion is permanent.

title: Manage keys and connected applications
steps: Trigger/preconditions: An external tool needs account access. Path: Create a personal key, copy its one-time secret, and later revoke it in API Keys. Connected apps exposes granted scopes and revocation. Webhooks management, when available, includes tests, delivery inspection, pause/resume, rotation, and deletion.
outcome: External access can be granted and withdrawn.
gaps: Account/backend flags may hide sections; revoking the current web authorization signs the user out.

title: Connect an AI agent through MCP
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Saved Notes and a compatible AI client exist. Path: Open Settings → Notes → Connect an AI Agent, select the tool, use the current setup, authorize in browser, then ask for a recent note. Revoke and repeat the scoped setup if the connection fails.
outcome: Hosted MCP enables read-only search and retrieval.
gaps: Some clients need a helper. Exact current command/client matrix is in-app; create/edit/delete are unavailable.

title: Use the CLI from a terminal
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A trusted terminal and personal Notes API key are available. Path: Copy the current install command from Mac Notes settings; provide the key to monologue onboarding and verify. Use notes list, query search, or notes get with an optional transcript field.
outcome: Scripts or local agents retrieve saved content.
gaps: CLI cannot create/edit/delete Notes. Revoking a reused key disconnects every tool using it; installed-version behavior was not tested.

title: Retrieve Notes and original audio by API
steps: Trigger/preconditions: An account with Notes and a notes:read token exists. Path: List/search/filter Notes, follow pagination, then fetch a note's detail for transcript segments and recording URL. Download the signed audio URL separately; refresh it after expiry.
outcome: Owner-authorized metadata, transcripts, and existing original audio are available.
gaps: Unknown/inaccessible Notes return 404. Public API docs say owner-only, unlike MCP's shared-note description; audio may be unavailable.

title: Receive processing events
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Webhooks is enabled and a public HTTPS receiver exists. Path: Create an endpoint, receive ping, then processed/failed events. Verify signatures on raw bytes, acknowledge promptly, and deduplicate event IDs. Settings supports test delivery and signing-secret rotation.
outcome: A user's server reacts to note completion or failure.
gaps: Private addresses are rejected. Deliveries may repeat or arrive out of order; repeated failures can disable delivery.

title: Record from Apple Watch and return on desktop
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A configured Watch app and synced Monologue account are assumed. Path: Every describes starting a Watch recording, keeping the phone pocketed, and retrieving the resulting Note with an agent at the computer. Mobile release notes describe background Watch uploads and recovery.
outcome: A mobile thought becomes shared account context.
gaps: Exact Watch start/stop controls, installation/sign-in, cellular independence, offline limits, and phone-free capture guarantees remain unknown.

title: Check entitlement and manage billing
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Trial allowance is exhausted or subscription management is needed. Path: Check Plan & Billing on Mac or Subscription on mobile. Manage through the listed purchase source: Apple, direct portal, Every, or team administrator. Confirm account identity before purchasing again.
outcome: Subscription access or cancellation is handled by its owner.
gaps: Canceling one source does not cancel another; credits/refunds do not necessarily transfer. Trial reset cadence and expiry behavior are unspecified.

title: Control local history and cloud data
steps: Trigger/preconditions: A user reviews retained data or contribution settings. Path: Data & Privacy deletes device-local dictation data and controls optional transcript sharing. Vendor privacy materials distinguish ephemeral Dictation processing from stored Notes audio/transcripts/summaries and synced personalization.
outcome: Local data or sharing preferences change without implying account deletion.
gaps: Zero-retention claims are vendor assertions. Policy includes opt-in storage exceptions; Note deletion timing, backups, and encryption details remain unresolved.

title: Diagnose errors and send contextual feedback
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Recording, quality, performance, or connectivity fails. Path: Save active work before restarting. Test a short example; isolate language/dictionary from mode formatting. Run Check connection in Help; it uploads synthetic test data and reports network performance. Send item-specific feedback or requested logs.
outcome: Support receives a reproducible example and relevant diagnostics.
gaps: A passing connection test cannot prove every backend works. Feedback can attach the affected dictation or Note.

title: Compose or edit text by voice
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Beta Mode is enabled on a release offering Compose. Path: The September 2026 release notes announce voice writing/editing with Compose.
outcome: A beta editing capability is claimed.
gaps: Invocation, selection scope, preview, accept/reject, undo, and error recovery are not publicly specified in examined guides.

title: Find Notes through system discovery
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Synced Notes are available on the documented OS/app version. Path: Release notes describe asking Siri AI to find/open Notes, discovering them in Spotlight, and accessing them through Shortcuts.
outcome: Saved context can be opened from system entry points.
gaps: Exact utterances, indexing/privacy settings, and failed-search handling are undocumented.

title: Integrate enterprise dictation
steps: Trigger/preconditions: Monologue approves an organization and provisions credentials. Path: The separate private-beta API offers batch audio/text formatting and realtime audio streaming; onboarding starts through Monologue support.
outcome: An approved application can use the dictation pipeline.
gaps: This is not the public Notes API. Self-service signup, pricing, hosted-region choices, and self-hosted deployment are not established.

title: Use context-sensitive writing in coding and communication apps
steps: Trigger/preconditions: An editable app field and relevant context are available. Path: Product examples show technical prompts, structured updates, conversational messages, and formatted email; cleanup retains final intent after spoken self-correction.
outcome: Text is shaped for the current task.
gaps: Exact app coverage, latency, error rate, selected-text rewriting, and preservation of identifiers are untested.

title: Install and onboard
steps: Download, move to Applications, launch; grant needed permissions; choose shortcut, model and Mode; start trial or activate.
outcome: Ready for first dictation.
gaps: Hardware wording conflicts; restart may be needed.

title: Activate, recover or move license
steps: Enter purchased key in VoiceInk Pro and Activate online; retrieve through checkout-email portal; deactivate an old Mac when needed.
outcome: Licensed Mac within purchased device allowance.
gaps: Trial expiry and offline revalidation unknown.

title: Download or import local models
steps: Download under AI Models > Local or import compatible Whisper .bin; choose model and supported language in a Mode.
outcome: Local transcription asset selected.
gaps: Interrupted download/disk-full recovery unknown; Apple Speech requires macOS 26.

title: Connect cloud BYOK
steps: Choose Cloud provider, enter key, Verify; select supported model in Mode.
outcome: Provider-backed transcription or enhancement.
gaps: Separate usage charges; no universal capability parity.

title: Connect custom endpoint
steps: Add full compatible endpoint, key, model ID and name under Custom; optionally Test; save and select in Mode.
outcome: Custom service configured.
gaps: Save does not verify; custom transcription is batch-only.

title: Record via shortcut
steps: Assign gesture and Toggle, Push to Talk, Hybrid or Double Tap; focus field; start, speak, stop; cancel if needed.
outcome: Recording enters processing.
gaps: Shortcut conflicts and locked-screen behavior unknown.

title: See live partial text
steps: Select streaming model, enable Mode Real-time and optional Live Text Display; dictate and finish.
outcome: Partial text during speech; final processing afterward.
gaps: Support is model-specific; imported files use batch.

title: Paste and optionally send
steps: Use Paste output and destination focus; finish dictation; configure restoration/delivery; use Return with Auto Send to send.
outcome: Text inserted; optional explicit send key.
gaps: Old content or no paste requires delay/focus/permission checks.

title: Manage Modes
steps: Create or edit task settings; select manually or through shortcut; duplicate, disable, or change default as needed.
outcome: Reusable dictation behavior.
gaps: Respond cannot default; distinct current Power Mode surface unestablished.

title: Trigger app/URL/word profiles
steps: Add Mode triggers; start in matching app/site or use spoken edge phrase after transcription.
outcome: Matching Mode governs processing.
gaps: First URL match wins; spoken trigger does not retranscribe; Firefox URL detection unsupported.

title: Enhance with custom prompt
steps: Enable enhancement, select provider/model/prompt; add named instructions and system-template preference; dictate.
outcome: Transformed text from configured prompt.
gaps: Short input may skip; timeout may retry or preserve original.

title: Rewrite using context
steps: Enable desired context in enhanced Mode; select text and dictate instruction; prompt references tagged inputs.
outcome: Context-assisted rewrite or reply.
gaps: Unavailable permissions skip sources; switches do not prevent all local snapshot reads.

title: Use local Refine cleanup
steps: Download Refine; select as enhanced Mode provider with separate speech model and Paste/Custom Command output.
outcome: Local text cleanup.
gaps: No custom prompt/context or Respond.

title: Converse with Assistant
steps: Configure compatible provider, Assistant prompt and Respond; record question; type or record follow-up; close to reset.
outcome: Answers remain in recorder; turns retained.
gaps: No automatic app control; Refine unsupported.

title: Add vocabulary
steps: Enter terms under Dictionary > Vocabulary; add, sort or remove; optionally use quick-add shortcut.
outcome: Recognition hints saved.
gaps: No guarantee all providers use terms identically.

title: Replace phrases and remove fillers
steps: Add original/replacement rules in Dictionary; edit filler list under AI Models transcription settings.
outcome: Substitution and cleanup applied.
gaps: Removing meaningful filler-list words may lose intent.

title: Learn corrected dictation
steps: Correct accessible inserted text; choose immediate or manual review; inspect, edit, apply or dismiss suggestions; retry pending failures.
outcome: Useful dictionary entries saved.
gaps: Local CLI eligibility conflicts with release feed.

title: Import or export dictionary
steps: Open Dictionary Data; export JSON or import, preview and confirm Merge/Replace.
outcome: Vocabulary and replacement entries exchanged.
gaps: No pending-review or provider data; invalid files rejected.

title: Recover or export saved result
steps: Search History/Quick History; inspect, replay, copy/paste or export CSV; retry retained audio with current Mode.
outcome: Recovered text or newly processed record.
gaps: No audio means no retry/playback; subtitle/audio export unknown.

title: Set retention or delete
steps: Choose transcript-plus-audio or audio-only retention; run eligible cleanup or delete selected records.
outcome: App records/audio removed according to policy.
gaps: Not forensic erasure; metrics may remain.

title: Transcribe imported media
steps: Add media to Transcribe; select batch-capable Mode; Start queue; copy/save completed result or cancel pending work.
outcome: Results and converted audio saved in History.
gaps: No live context, triggers or output side effects; file-size limits unknown.

title: Choose microphone
steps: Pin default/device or rank Audio inputs; refresh devices and check system levels; configure feedback/media pause.
outcome: Selected input and fallback preference set.
gaps: Mid-recording loss and meeting system-audio capture unknown.

title: Deliver to custom command
steps: Set Mode Custom Command and nonempty command/template; dictate; inspect delivery logs if needed.
outcome: Final text supplied to local command.
gaps: Ten-second timeout; no app success/failure acknowledgement; no file-queue execution.

title: Enhance through CLI
steps: Install/authenticate tool; configure Local CLI command/timeout; select it in Mode; return final text on stdout.
outcome: Command produces enhanced text.
gaps: May use hosted service; Auto Learn eligibility conflicts.

title: Back up and restore configuration
steps: Export settings JSON; import selected categories; separately reconnect providers, models and licenses.
outcome: Supported configuration moved or restored.
gaps: Modes/prompts replace; dictionary merges; excludes complete app data.

title: Configure local processing
steps: Choose local speech model, local/no enhancement, and disabled/local Auto Learn; inspect command/endpoint routing.
outcome: Documented on-device processing configuration.
gaps: No network audit; licensing/download connectivity separate.

title: Quick Dictation through iOS shortcut
steps: Complete setup and enable Live Activities; install Quick Dictation; assign Action Button/Back Tap; trigger start/stop and manually paste.
outcome: Transcript copied for insertion.
gaps: Does not automatically paste; full keyboard onboarding separate.

title: iOS keyboard and sharing
steps: Listing/release notes identify voice keyboard, audio-share import and transcript sharing; exact interaction path unestablished.
outcome: Advertised mobile transcription and sharing.
gaps: Keyboard permissions, app switching and share-sheet details unknown.

title: Diagnose and export logs
steps: Check permissions, input, Mode, language/model and output; export Diagnostics archive or copy system information.
outcome: Support evidence available for review.
gaps: No automatic support submission; unsaved-audio recovery unknown.

title: Inspect usage/performance
steps: Open Dashboard > View Insights; select period; inspect activity/model timings.
outcome: Estimated productivity and usage view.
gaps: Not provider billing; metric deletion control unknown.

title: Change language and app behavior
steps: Choose supported Mode language/model; change interface language and restart; configure startup, recorder, updates or onboarding reset.
outcome: Language and application behavior adjusted.
gaps: Translation/mixed-language reliability and update rollback unknown.

title: Install and authorize the Mac app
steps: Preconditions: macOS 12+, correct Intel or Apple Silicon installer. Path: Move Wispr Flow.app directly into an accepted Applications folder; launch; grant Accessibility and Microphone; continue.
outcome: App can proceed to setup.
gaps: Wrong location or architecture exits; retry timed-out permission requests. Install guide limits Input Monitoring to standalone Caps Lock, unlike S05.

title: Create an account and finish onboarding
steps: Preconditions: Installed app; internet and an identity provider. Path: Use browser sign-in on desktop or mobile sign-in; complete permissions, microphone test, shortcut/language choices, practice and data preference.
outcome: Hub or mobile Home opens; unfinished setup can resume.
gaps: Google, Apple, Microsoft, SSO and email/password supported; provider mismatch and expired verification require restarting sign-in. Organization screens vary.

title: Dictate into another app
steps: Preconditions: Setup complete; text field focused. Path: Hold the dictation shortcut, speak, release, then review inserted text.
outcome: Completed text appears at the cursor after stopping.
gaps: Default Mac Fn becomes Ctrl+Option without Apple Fn. Desktop output is not a live word-by-word transcript; transcription requires connectivity.

title: Change activation and recovery shortcuts
steps: Preconditions: Settings accessible; supported keyboard or mouse. Path: Open General → Shortcuts → Change; select a binding; record keys; release to save; finish with Done.
outcome: Device-specific binding replaces or supplements the old one.
gaps: Three-key maximum; four bindings per action except Cancel. Reserved/duplicate combinations fail. Reset has no undo; bindings do not sync.

title: Run hands-free and recover a failed insertion
steps: Preconditions: Signed in; permissions and word allowance. Path: Press Fn+Space on Mac, double-tap push-to-talk, or click Flow Bar; speak; stop. Use Paste Last Transcript or History recovery after failure.
outcome: Text pastes; retained audio can be retried.
gaps: Esc/X cancels; rapid triple-tap cancels. Recording ends at 20 minutes. Offline recording may save audio, but retry requires retained audio; never-store prevents recovery.

title: Choose writing style
steps: Preconditions: Personalization available; iPhone external-app trial completed. Path: Open Style; complete guided categories; choose a style card. In iPhone Default Sound layout choose the card and Save.
outcome: New dictations use chosen capitalization and punctuation.
gaps: Desktop categories are Personal, Work, Email, Other; iPhone has alternate layouts. Formal/Casual and category-dependent Very casual/Excited differ. Notices limit style formatting to English.

title: Use or disable app context
steps: Preconditions: Dictation target provides readable context. Path: Dictate normally for automatic app/category adaptation; desktop Data and Privacy can disable Context awareness.
outcome: Names, casing and formatting adapt to nearby text.
gaps: Desktop still sends app/domain and locally matches surrounding text when disabled. iPhone has no switch. Standard password fields are excluded; custom/web fields may not be.

title: Select languages and regional spelling
steps: Preconditions: Language settings accessible. Path: Choose Auto-detect or selected languages; desktop saves explicitly, iPhone saves each tap; start another dictation.
outcome: Saved choices constrain recognition and spelling/script.
gaps: Docs specify one detected language per dictation; Hinglish requires explicit selection. Wrong-language output suggests selecting one language. Mixed-sentence onboarding claims remain unresolved.

title: Correct yourself while speaking
steps: Preconditions: Active dictation. Path: Speak naturally, self-correct with context, or name punctuation/paragraph breaks; finish dictation.
outcome: Smart Formatting removes clear false starts and creates structure.
gaps: Backtrack is contextual, not a guaranteed literal command. Misheard words need other correction. Original and formatted versions can differ; some punctuation names may fail.

title: Control cleanup and restore the original
steps: Preconditions: Auto Cleanup beta available. Path: Open Style → Auto Cleanup; choose None, Light or Medium. For unwanted changes, use Home row menu → Undo AI edit.
outcome: Next dictation changes cleanup level; original text can be recovered.
gaps: None preserves fillers; Light is default; Medium can reword. AI-app/command paths and formatting failures may bypass cleanup. Recovery still depends on retained history.

title: Teach vocabulary and exact replacements
steps: Preconditions: Dictionary unlocked. Path: Add a word; optionally enable Correct a misspelling and provide the wrong form; save and dictate again. Edit or delete entries later.
outcome: Vocabulary improves recognition; corrections replace matching words.
gaps: Desktop fields allow 60 characters, iPhone 59. Corrections are literal. Eligible manual edits can auto-teach terms; deleting a learned desktop word prevents automatic re-addition.

title: Expand reusable spoken snippets
steps: Preconditions: Snippets unlocked; personal snippets include Basic. Path: Add a distinctive trigger and expansion; save; speak the trigger during dictation.
outcome: Saved text replaces the trigger.
gaps: Desktop expansion limit is 4,000 characters; variables are unsupported. Duplicate/conflicting triggers and rich-text destination support matter. Failed iPhone edits can remove the local original.

title: Import vocabulary or snippets
steps: Preconditions: Eligible paid/trial account; Experimental Bulk import enabled. Path: Open library Import; choose personal/team destination; upload dictionary CSV or snippet JSON; inspect preview/skips; confirm.
outcome: Valid entries enter the selected library and sync when allowed.
gaps: Files max 3 MB; max 1,000 valid nonduplicate entries. Malformed rows skip; failed imports return to upload. Team sharing can move personal entries.

title: Inspect, copy or remove dictation history
steps: Preconditions: A locally retained dictation exists. Path: Open Home history; find an entry; copy its text or retry retained audio. On iPhone long-press → Delete → confirm.
outcome: Transcript can be reused or removed.
gaps: History is device-specific; deletion is permanent and may not remove cloud copies. iPhone swipe exposes actions but does not delete. Report submits transcript/audio/logs.

title: Issue a spoken edit or search command
steps: Preconditions: Eligible paid/trial access; Command Mode enabled in Experimental. Path: Focus editable text; hold Fn+Ctrl on Mac; speak an instruction; release.
outcome: Text changes in place; search can open Perplexity.
gaps: Current field and selection accompany the request. No usable text can produce no edit; no editable field yields a notification. iPhone in-place editing is explicitly not working.

title: Rewrite with Transforms and custom prompts
steps: Preconditions: Transforms available and opted in. Path: Run guided sample; select text and activate Polish or a saved prompt; inspect View Diff; copy, retry or undo.
outcome: Rewrite replaces text or opens in Scratchpad.
gaps: Desktop accepts 1–1,000 words; iPhone Polish 10–1,000. Custom name/prompt/shortcut required. Auto Apply runs after dictation; failure falls back to original text. Organization policy can disable it.

title: Install the iPhone keyboard
steps: Preconditions: Flow installed, opened and signed in. Path: iOS Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard; add Flow, enable Full Access; allow microphone in Flow; choose Flow with globe.
outcome: Keyboard can dictate into standard text fields.
gaps: Missing permissions replace controls with setup guidance. Custom fields may reject third-party keyboards; number/phone/email fields switch keyboards. Calls or headset changes stop capture.

title: Start, finish and recover an iPhone session
steps: Preconditions: Flow keyboard active; microphone and Full Access granted. Path: Tap Start Flow; return automatically or swipe along bottom edge; speak; stop with primary control; wait for insertion.
outcome: Text returns to the active field.
gaps: Busy sessions block a new start; pressing during processing cancels. Exact-place versus app-only return differs between docs. Disable Flow after exists, but timer choices/session semantics were not established.

title: Launch capture with iPhone system actions
steps: Preconditions: Microphone, Full Access and required Live Activities enabled. Path: Assign Flow action to Action Button, Back Tap, Shortcuts/Siri or Control Center; trigger; speak; trigger again or stop in Live Activity.
outcome: Action inserts into active Flow keyboard or returns/copies/saves text according to action.
gaps: Without active keyboard, clipboard and note actions differ. Starts can require Live Activities; stopping is not blocked. Action Button and Dynamic Island depend on device.

title: Capture and manage iPhone notes
steps: Preconditions: Scratchpad unlocked; first note requires keyboard setup. Path: Create note; dictate using editor mic; stop; wait for text; leave editor. Quick capture instead requires explicit Save.
outcome: In-app edits autosave; saved notes can be searched, copied or shared.
gaps: Leaving during dictation discards unfinished speech. Quick capture never autosaves. Delete propagates through sync; clearing title and body can delete without confirmation. Restricted accounts may remain local.

title: Draft in desktop Scratchpad
steps: Preconditions: Scratchpad enabled by organization. Path: Create note; type or dictate; use tabs, pins and search; restore a saved version if needed.
outcome: Draft autosaves and can sync independently of dictation storage.
gaps: Five tabs per window; up to 50 versions. Pins stay local. Deletion permanently removes history; images have separate upload and platform limits.

title: Use the same account across devices
steps: Preconditions: Devices online and signed into same original account/provider. Path: Confirm matching email/plan; change a dictionary entry on one device; wait and check the other; refresh/restart if needed.
outcome: Dictionary, snippets and supported preferences sync.
gaps: Shortcuts, microphone and sounds stay local; history lists local dictations. Concurrent preference changes can overwrite each other. Sign-out destroys local-only content; sync latency is not guaranteed.

title: Set training, cloud and local-data preferences
steps: Preconditions: Signed in; policy permits changes. Path: Open Data and Privacy; independently set model improvement, dictation cloud storage, context and local retention; confirm destructive retention changes.
outcome: Chosen controls alter separate data uses.
gaps: Opting out of training does not disable cloud processing. Local options include 24-hour deletion and never-store. BAA/policy locks apply; meeting storage and Scratchpad follow separate rules.

title: Export retained account data
steps: Preconditions: Data export allowed for account. Path: Data and Privacy → Download your data → Request a copy; wait for readiness email; download ZIP.
outcome: Export contains retained dictations, meetings, notes and settings.
gaps: Preparation can be cancelled; download expires after 30 days. Never-uploaded/local-only history is absent. Organization restrictions, cooldowns or large accounts can block export.

title: Manage identity, sign out or delete account
steps: Preconditions: Account accessible; save needed local work. Path: Edit profile in Account; sign out to change identity. Delete account requires confirmation and exact email on desktop.
outcome: Profile updates or account-deletion request is submitted.
gaps: Email/provider changes are not normal profile edits. Sign-out clears local data. iPhone sign-out does not prove deletion succeeded; store subscriptions require separate cancellation and other-device local history can remain.

title: Publish and govern team vocabulary
steps: Preconditions: Active eligible team membership; admin role for policy. Path: Use shared library for team entries; administrators select Unrestricted or Department only in Organization settings.
outcome: Shared words/snippets become usable within allowed scope.
gaps: Department only blocks nonadmin org-wide changes, preserving existing entries. Team imports do not create org-wide entries. Save failures roll settings back; plan naming varies.

title: Choose, trial or purchase a plan
steps: Preconditions: Correct account and billing owner. Path: Open Plans and Billing; select individual/team plan or eligible student claim; complete provider checkout.
outcome: Subscription grants plan features across devices.
gaps: Pro list price is $15/month or $144/year. Student free claim is desktop-only. Growth/Enterprise, trials and Notetaker access differ by organization; paid Notetaker documents a 150-meeting weekly cap.

title: Handle allowance warnings or stale usage
steps: Preconditions: Free plan or unexpected limit. Path: Inspect usage and plan; restart/refresh; upgrade or wait for reset; contact support if inconsistent.
outcome: Allowance or paid access becomes usable when confirmed.
gaps: Desktop soft/hard caps: 2,000/5,000 words; shared mobile pool: 1,000/1,500. Help specifies Sunday 23:45 UTC despite midnight-PT UI wording. Clearing history does not renew allowance.

title: Dictate quietly
steps: Preconditions: Suitable microphone proximity. Path: Use ordinary dictation while speaking quietly.
outcome: Vendor claims recognition down to whisper volume.
gaps: No separate Whisper Mode toggle, calibration path, noise threshold or measured whisper accuracy was established. Treat this as positioning, not a verified mode.

title: Navigate without a pointer or with a screen reader
steps: Preconditions: Keyboard/screen reader available. Path: Use Tab/Shift+Tab, arrows and activation keys; navigate history and settings; enable system Reduce Motion if desired.
outcome: Supported controls expose keyboard and assistive labels.
gaps: Vendor reports Mac VoiceOver testing, but documents mouse-only Flow Bar menus, unnamed icons, hover-only explanations and incomplete older dialogs. iPhone key labels ignore accessibility text sizing.

title: Diagnose silence, unavailable input or missing text
steps: Preconditions: A dictation fails or captures no speech. Path: Check mute and permissions; test another recorder; select/test desktop input; inspect saved audio; retry transcription or contact support.
outcome: Separates capture failure from transcription failure.
gaps: Never-captured or never-stored audio cannot recover. iPhone interruptions require restarting capture. Closing a recording bubble may not stop capture; explicitly stop before microphone recovery.

title: Connect or revoke a calendar/Slack integration
steps: Preconditions: Connector offered and allowed. Path: Settings → Connectors → Connect; authenticate in browser and grant requested access; confirm connected row. Use row menu to disconnect.
outcome: Calendar reminders/context or Slack context becomes available.
gaps: Partial calendar authorization needs completion; changing accounts can require disconnection. Admin-disabled existing connections remain authorized but unavailable. Disconnect can affect briefs; existing meeting-linked calendar events remain.

title: Capture and stop a meeting
steps: Preconditions: Notetaker access, onboarding, consent and audio permissions. Path: Open New note or scheduled Join and record; follow live transcript and personal notes; explicitly Stop; await saved transcript/summary.
outcome: Meeting becomes reviewable; closing notepad alone keeps recording.
gaps: One meeting at a time. Optional auto-start requires detection and rollout access. Default limit two hours; configurable 30 minutes–three hours. Short meetings may need Generate summary; BAA/policy can block.

title: Review speakers, summary and meeting questions
steps: Preconditions: Saved or active accessible meeting. Path: Open Transcript/Summary/My thoughts; assign speaker names; edit notes or summary; ask a question or explicit edit through Ask anything.
outcome: Meeting context becomes readable and reusable.
gaps: Transcript is not editable. Updated summary replaces manual summary edits; personal notes stay separate. Sending another question stops prior reply. Markdown copy includes private notes and chat, unlike normal sharing.

title: Share a meeting or folder
steps: Preconditions: Sharing permitted; saved meeting accessible. Path: Open Share; add people, choose visibility and copy link; alternatively file into a shared folder.
outcome: Invited users or link recipients access permitted meeting content.
gaps: Links expose summaries; transcript access needs direct invitation and owner policy. Shared folders have contributors, no view-only role. Policy blocks sharing; failed changes roll back. Cloud Sync wording is internally inconsistent.

title: Set meeting retention or delete a meeting
steps: Preconditions: Meeting ownership; retention policy editable. Path: Choose retention interval in Data and Privacy and confirm shortening; or select past meeting delete and confirm.
outcome: Old transcripts expire or whole meeting disappears.
gaps: Transcript retention leaves notes/summary; uploaded audio separately expires after seven days. Whole-meeting deletion removes associated content irreversibly. Failed deletion can make the row reappear.

title: Read meeting knowledge from an AI client
steps: Preconditions: Notetaker/MCP access and allowed account policy. Path: Settings → MCP; open client setup or copy server URL; authorize correct account; ask about a known meeting.
outcome: Client reads allowed meeting, note, calendar and task data.
gaps: Read-only; no dictation-history access. Account-wide consent, not per meeting. Disconnect in client. BAA or organizational restrictions block access; displayed client card does not prove authorization.

title: Import previous meetings
steps: Preconditions: Signed in; import source enabled; provider export obtained. Path: Notetaker import card → Granola/Otter → upload supported export; keep Flow open; inspect completion and transcript progress.
outcome: Past text notes/summaries/transcripts enter Flow.
gaps: No audio or calendar linkage imported. Partial/skipped records require checking; background transcript work can continue after meeting rows appear. Cloud upload has separate policy implications; reimport can restore deleted records.

title: View upcoming meetings on iPhone
steps: Preconditions: Calendar connected, online, eligible non-Enterprise account. Path: Open Notetaker Home and inspect upcoming/imminent events.
outcome: Next five events and countdowns provide schedule context.
gaps: Tapping an upcoming card does not start recording. Page labels content as desktop-recorded yet mentions Start/record controls; full iPhone recording path and rollout are UNKNOWN.

title: Continue capture without internet
steps: Preconditions: Notetaker eligible; working local storage. Path: Start offline; when prompted choose Record offline. Reconnect for later transcription/processing.
outcome: Audio is retained locally pending processing.
gaps: Offline mode is not offline transcription. Refusing prompt cancels start; inability to save locally blocks or stops offline capture. Complete retry/backoff behavior was not captured.

title: Cancel renewal or retrieve invoices
steps: Preconditions: Know purchasing provider and authorized billing role. Path: Open personal Stripe, team admin billing, or Apple subscription management; cancel renewal or download invoice/receipt there.
outcome: Provider manages renewal/payment records.
gaps: Store purchases cannot be managed in desktop Stripe. Mobile app has no invoice viewer; deleting account/signing out does not cancel store subscriptions. Verify provider confirmation.

title: Install and authorize dictation
steps: Install in Applications; grant microphone and Accessibility; choose language, model and input.
outcome: Dictation can paste into other apps.
gaps: Denied permissions require system-settings repair.

title: Dictate at the cursor
steps: Focus a field; use toggle or hold-to-talk; speak and stop.
outcome: Processed text is inserted.
gaps: Global and per-mode shortcuts may conflict.

title: Inspect, stop or cancel capture
steps: Inspect main/mini recording window; stop to process or cancel to discard.
outcome: Capture has explicit completion and abandonment paths.
gaps: Under-30-second cancellation discards immediately; system capture has a stationary waveform.

title: Choose local or cloud processing
steps: Create a mode; independently choose speech and optional language models; download local models.
outcome: The mode defines processing location.
gaps: Bundled S1-mini is English-only and limited to Message/Mail.

title: Select realtime-compatible speech
steps: Choose a supported voice model and enable Realtime.
outcome: Words appear during capture.
gaps: Parakeet/Scribe cannot combine Realtime with Identify Speakers; Whisper/Cohere lack realtime.

title: Apply a writing preset
steps: Create Message, Mail, Note or Super mode; dictate with the desired preset.
outcome: Output follows a communication purpose.
gaps: A Note preset is not evidence of a linked-note knowledge base.

title: Create a custom transformation
steps: Create Custom mode; write instructions, optional examples and needed context choices.
outcome: A reusable transformation processes dictation.
gaps: Empty instructions are ambiguous; exact platform parity untested.

title: Inspect captured context
steps: Enable needed context types; dictate with the target active; inspect the prompt in History.
outcome: The user can examine AI input.
gaps: Context and identity details may reach the chosen language provider.

title: Switch manually or by app
steps: Use mode menu/shortcut, or assign apps and sites in a mode.
outcome: A task-specific mode becomes active.
gaps: Conflicting auto-activation rules and stale context require testing.

title: Teach terms and expand phrases
steps: Add vocabulary hints or a From/To replacement; dictate the term or phrase.
outcome: Recognition is guided or text is replaced deterministically.
gaps: Hints are not guaranteed corrections; cloud hints accompany audio.

title: Record a meeting with system audio
steps: Grant Screen/System Audio permission; enable system audio in the selected mode; start and stop capture.
outcome: Microphone plus computer playback feeds transcription.
gaps: Notifications can enter the recording; guide limits app capture to main display; no roster API established.

title: Generate meeting minutes
steps: Choose Meeting mode; capture conversation and finish.
outcome: AI structures discussion, decisions and actions.
gaps: Speaker separation is optional; speaker labels are excluded from automatic summaries.

title: Separate and rename speakers
steps: Enable Identify Speakers; capture or import; open History Segments and rename labels.
outcome: Transcript distinguishes named speaker segments.
gaps: No automatic meeting-display-name mapping is documented.

title: Analyze a labeled transcript
steps: Copy the Segments transcript into an editor; invoke a context-enabled Custom mode with an analysis request.
outcome: AI receives speaker labels for follow-up analysis.
gaps: Separate multi-step workflow; attribution accuracy untested.

title: Import an existing recording
steps: Select the desired mode; use Transcribe File, Finder Open With, or the CLI import command.
outcome: Existing audio/video enters the processing pipeline.
gaps: Active mode controls routing; batch queue and interruption guarantees unknown.

title: Search and replay history
steps: Open History; search original dictated text and inspect a recording.
outcome: Past audio, transcript and processed result remain accessible.
gaps: Search excludes processed output; immutability and crash durability unproven.

title: Reprocess without recording again
steps: Open a prior dictation; invoke reprocess and select another mode.
outcome: Saved audio can produce another result.
gaps: The docs do not guarantee prior result versions survive.

title: Recover an AI-processing failure
steps: Use pasted raw text; repair network/model/key; retry the saved dictation in History.
outcome: An AI failure need not require repeating speech.
gaps: This does not establish recovery from missing audio or app termination.

title: Set recording retention
steps: Choose Forever or a shorter period in Configuration; review deletion warning.
outcome: Stored recordings follow the selected retention rule.
gaps: Default is Forever; enterprise maximum may override; deletion can prevent reprocessing.

title: Back up and restore the working folder
steps: Locate app folder; copy needed configuration and recordings; restore on another computer and restart.
outcome: A manual copy preserves setup and history.
gaps: No snapshot protocol; iCloud offloading can break active-folder writes.

title: Sync configuration between Macs
steps: Enable Filesync on Macs sharing a license.
outcome: Supported configuration travels through vendor infrastructure.
gaps: Audio/history are excluded; iOS/Windows configuration sync is unavailable.

title: Add a provider or self-hosted language endpoint
steps: Add BYOK model, or configure enterprise provider, model ID and API URL; assign it to a mode.
outcome: Text processing uses the selected provider.
gaps: Enterprise custom models are language-only; compatible chat endpoint and TLS required; no self-hosted app backend established.

title: Search and export through the CLI
steps: Use search/history/read or export JSONL/Markdown from local recordings.
outcome: Shell workflows consume transcription data.
gaps: Export is documented for text; complete archival audio export unverified.

title: Connect an assistant through MCP
steps: Run the CLI MCP server over stdio; configure the assistant to use it.
outcome: Assistant can query history and manage vocabulary/snippets.
gaps: Queried text leaves the local boundary according to the assistant settings; MCP app-control parity not documented.

title: Control recording through automation
steps: Invoke explicit start/stop or mode deep links/CLI controls against the running app.
outcome: External tools steer capture without toggle ambiguity.
gaps: No generic event-hook contract or XDG directory contract established.

title: Answer coding agents by voice
steps: Install a detected agent plugin; restart the agent; respond to questions or approval requests in Superwhisper.
outcome: Voice replies and completion notices connect agent work to capture UI.
gaps: Agent permissions remain separate; no unattended approval behavior inferred.

title: Enable and use the iPhone keyboard
steps: Add Superwhisper keyboard and Full Access; select via globe; record; manually return if opened; stop to insert.
outcome: Dictation reaches the current text field.
gaps: iOS 26.4+ return is manual per vendor; iPad unsupported.

title: Recall an iPhone recording
steps: Open app History, or search for a recording through Spotlight/Siri.
outcome: Mobile capture remains discoverable outside the keyboard.
gaps: Cross-device history sync is not established.

title: Activate Pro across devices
steps: Purchase or recover a license; enter it on desktop and scan its QR code or enter it on iPhone.
outcome: One entitlement covers supported devices.
gaps: Free has two non-AI modes; Pro gates system capture, separation, BYOK and imports.

title: Delete account or local recordings
steps: Request account deletion separately; remove local recordings or app data when intended.
outcome: Service identity and device data have distinct deletion paths.
gaps: Uninstall alone retains the data folder; account deletion leaves local history.

title: Choose distribution and entitlement
steps: Choose direct MacWhisper or store Whisper Transcription; activate the matching purchase.
outcome: Correct client and entitlement.
gaps: Direct licenses do not unlock store purchases; direct-only features differ.

title: Download and select a local model
steps: Open Manage Models, filter by engine, download and activate.
outcome: Local transcription model ready.
gaps: WhisperKit requires Apple Silicon; first preparation can take time.

title: Transcribe an imported recording
steps: Drop an audio/video file; select language and model; transcribe.
outcome: Editable transcript.
gaps: Format/model coverage varies; no accuracy benchmark.

title: Batch-process a backlog
steps: Open several files together; add export formats; process the batch.
outcome: Several recordings become several output formats.
gaps: URL batches undocumented in current version; partial failure recovery untested.

title: Capture a quick voice memo globally
steps: Configure shortcut; invoke floating Global panel; record and optionally auto-copy.
outcome: Microphone transcript available across apps.
gaps: Global is distinct from automatic text-field insertion and system-audio capture.

title: Record app or system audio
steps: Choose app/system audio and optional microphone; grant capture permission; record.
outcome: Local recording available.
gaps: Mac 15.4 documents CoreAudio on macOS 26+; older path ScreenCaptureKit.

title: Accept a meeting capture prompt
steps: Enable meeting notifications and observed apps; accept detected-call prompt; stop after meeting.
outcome: Recording appears in history.
gaps: Browser detection is documented, exact Zoom/Meet signal is not; old guide labels beta.

title: Follow and correct a live meeting
steps: Enable live transcription; follow transcript; rename or merge speakers.
outcome: Readable live speaker turns.
gaps: Highlighting a speaker does not prove Zoom/Meet identity extraction.

title: Review and name diarized speakers
steps: Inspect numbered speakers; rename, merge duplicates and choose colors.
outcome: Corrected speaker labels.
gaps: Suggested existing names are not proof of persistent voice recognition.

title: Correct transcript segments with the keyboard
steps: Navigate playback; edit/split text; use number keys to reassign selected speaker segments.
outcome: Transcript and attribution corrected.
gaps: Undo depth and preserved correction history unknown.

title: Build a transcript from separate podcast tracks
steps: Import individual speaker tracks into Transcribe Podcast.
outcome: Track-based speaker separation.
gaps: This path assumes each track represents one speaker; not acoustic diarization.

title: Review text against original media
steps: Play synchronized audio/video; search text, adjust speed and mark passages.
outcome: Review stays anchored to recording.
gaps: Playback responsiveness and corrupted-media handling untested.

title: Use a remote transcription provider
steps: Add provider key or compatible custom endpoint in transcription settings; select it in model picker.
outcome: Audio transcribed remotely.
gaps: Provider limits and network errors vary; older help ceilings are stale.

title: Connect a local or self-hosted text model
steps: Start Ollama/LM Studio or compatible server; add endpoint and model; select in AI picker.
outcome: Transcript prompts processed by chosen server.
