gaps: Text-AI choice does not change audio-transcription routing; server compatibility varies.

title: Summarize, ask questions or translate
steps: Open transcript; choose summary, chat or supported translation; use Assistant or BYOK.
outcome: Derived text for reading or reuse.
gaps: Hosted mode sends content off-device; citation and hallucination behavior untested.

title: Dictate into another Mac app
steps: Complete Dictation setup; bind shortcut; speak into focused text field.
outcome: Recognized text inserted.
gaps: AI cleanup uses separate prompt/provider setup; secure-field and focus behavior untested.

title: Use app-specific writing transformations
steps: Add running apps in Dictation settings; assign saved prompts; dictate there.
outcome: Per-app tone or transformation applied.
gaps: App identity granularity and fallback when app is missing untested.

title: Maintain reusable vocabulary corrections
steps: Add replacement pairs and match rules; import/export the list as JSON.
outcome: Future transcripts use replacements.
gaps: Not retroactive; substring matching can alter unintended words.

title: Create subtitles and video review outputs
steps: Open media; transcribe; view synchronized subtitles and export chosen format.
outcome: Shareable subtitles or document.
gaps: Translation/model limits and precise export fidelity require sample files.

title: Import an online video
steps: Paste a YouTube URL and submit.
outcome: Online media becomes a transcript.
gaps: Age, country and some live-video restrictions apply.

title: Automate imports through watched folders
steps: Add folder; choose automatic processing or notification; configure export presets.
outcome: New recordings trigger processing.
gaps: Readiness, interrupted copies and replay need tests; old guide is beta.

title: Send completed transcripts to a webhook
steps: Configure n8n/Zapier/Make/custom destination; send test; enable automatic delivery.
outcome: Endpoint receives transcript payload.
gaps: Retries, duplicate suppression and offline backlog are unspecified.

title: Send transcripts into Obsidian
steps: Configure local REST plugin and token; add endpoint in MacWhisper; test.
outcome: Markdown note created or updated.
gaps: Plugin required; same-title overwrite and transport settings need verification.

title: Compose transcription from the terminal
steps: Install mw from Advanced settings; transcribe files to stdout/JSON or pipe results onward.
outcome: Scriptable app-backed transcription.
gaps: App runs behind local socket; --persist opts into history, --overwrite into replacement.

title: Keep a portable recording project
steps: Save/export a .whisper archive after editing.
outcome: Original audio and transcript edits travel together.
gaps: Archive export is not automatic backup or versioned history.

title: Recover and reprocess saved work
steps: Reopen history and retranscribe; restore eligible deleted transcripts.
outcome: Saved work can be revisited.
gaps: Release notes report safeguards; crash durability and immutable versions unproven.

title: Capture or import on iPhone and iPad
steps: Record in-app or share a media file; choose local model or cloud provider.
outcome: Mobile transcript with summary/chat options.
gaps: Older help hardware limits differ from current store listing; local download required.

title: Dictate through an iOS keyboard
steps: Set up keyboard; select via Globe; follow recording handoff; return to destination.
outcome: Text enters another app.
gaps: Release 4.1 says return requires manual swipe; current handoff reliability untested.

title: Find mobile history through Apple surfaces
steps: Search history or use supported Shortcuts/Siri/Spotlight actions.
outcome: Saved transcripts reusable outside app.
gaps: Indexing can be disabled; cross-device sync is not established.

title: Apply inspectable managed settings
steps: Deploy profile or fallback plist; inspect Loaded From in MDM settings.
outcome: Policies and providers configured predictably.
gaps: Profile precedence is documented; not an XDG configuration contract.

title: Install and try a private demo
steps: Install matching build; grant microphone/system audio; optionally sign in; open Welcome note; Join & record; stop and inspect views.
outcome: Demo creates a concrete note/transcript/summary experience.
gaps: Local provider setup still needed for offline processing; no permissions or demo tested.

title: Connect calendars and recurring filing
steps: Connect Apple Calendar or authorize Google/Outlook; enable calendars; open an event; assign a folder and optionally Auto-add future recurrences.
outcome: Event links and participant context accompany meeting notes.
gaps: Cloud calendars require sign-in; folder rules remain device-local; removing an account preserves existing notes.

title: Record a scheduled or ad-hoc conversation
steps: Open event or New Note; choose Join & record or Record; write Memos while microphone and computer audio are captured.
outcome: One note contains personal writing and captured conversation.
gaps: No participant bot; recording depends on OS access and selected engine.

title: Configure automatic start and meeting reminders
steps: Enable scheduled start/join or sustained-microphone reminders; choose delay/exclusions; optionally stop on microphone release and capture/disclose chat.
outcome: Calendar starts or reminders reduce missed meetings.
gaps: Overlaps are skipped; microphone reminders do not auto-record; auto-stop can misfire on device changes.

title: Finish and resume an existing conversation
steps: Stop listening; review completed output; later choose Resume listening from Transcript.
outcome: Related recording continues in the same meeting note.
gaps: Retention may remove audio; multiple-session timeline behavior untested.

title: Repair one failed audio source
steps: Inspect unavailable mic/system-source warning; correct device or permission; press Retry.
outcome: Working channel keeps recording while failed source restarts.
gaps: Retry cannot recover audio never captured; no crash/storage fault tests performed.

title: Choose local or remote models independently
steps: Select Transcription provider/model; independently configure Intelligence; use on-device speech plus local LLM server when desired.
outcome: Capture, transcription and generation have explicit processing destinations.
gaps: Some engines are after-recording only; model/language/timestamp support differs; hosted web search can still send queries.

title: Steer and regenerate a summary
steps: Write memo context; choose named template or edit Auto format; add dictionary terms; explicitly regenerate.
outcome: Summary follows selected structure and available context.
gaps: Changing template alone does not regenerate; quality and version rollback untested.

title: Correct transcript words and speaker assignments
steps: Enter Write mode; edit words; save; select labels or a text range to reassign speaker; apply globally where appropriate.
outcome: Human corrections repair transcript content and speaker mapping.
gaps: Correction fidelity and cross-generation history untested.

title: Re-transcribe retained audio
steps: Preserve wanted transcript externally; right-click Transcript; re-transcribe with selected engine; review replacement.
outcome: Existing recording produces a new current transcript.
gaps: Current transcript is permanently replaced; deleted audio cannot be used; immutable generations not established.

title: Import audio or timed text
steps: Create/open empty note; upload or drop audio, or upload SRT/VTT; keep app open while configured providers process it.
outcome: External media or timed transcript becomes a meeting note.
gaps: Transcript-only import contains no audio; absent provider or unsupported file blocks processing.

title: Migrate another meeting library
steps: Export supported source data; open Imports; choose files or supported official connection; review imported/matched/conflict/error counts.
outcome: Available text metadata and speakers enter the library without duplicating matches.
gaps: Text-based migration does not copy original audio/video; conflicts require review.

title: Import Zoom cloud meeting text
steps: Sign in; connect recording-owner Zoom account through Imports; authorize; keep app open or Sync now; inspect imported notes.
outcome: Available cloud-recording transcripts/summaries become notes.
gaps: External access awaits Zoom review; scans about six months; no audio/video copied; not a live speaker API.

title: Recall and organize meeting context with Chat
steps: Open note and Chat; ask or drag another meeting as context; inspect Activity; ask for history or folder organization; review proposed edits.
outcome: Answers and follow-up drafts use selected meeting context.
gaps: No removable context chips; new chat needed to reset history; answer correctness untested.

title: Share a summary with controlled access
steps: Open Share on summarized note; review invitees and access; invite/email/link; optionally add retained audio; later revoke or replace link.
outcome: Others receive an authorized summary with optional collaboration.
gaps: Private memo excluded; opening panel alone sends nothing; suggested attendees must be reviewed before Invite.

title: Export a portable meeting
steps: Choose Export with desired sections and PDF/text/Markdown/Org, or use CLI complete Markdown/JSON export.
outcome: A meeting becomes a portable artifact.
gaps: Export content differs between GUI and CLI; full raw-audio backup is separate.

title: Sync notes and add another device
platform: Desktop and supported mobile beta; Pro
steps: Sign in on new device; keep existing synced device online for encrypted key transfer; wait for notes; configure providers separately.
outcome: Supported note/transcript/participant data becomes available on the new device.
gaps: Fresh Pro login auto-enables sync; saved audio/attachments and new folders/tags/daily notes do not sync; lost keys unrecoverable.

title: Control audio retention and preserve originals
steps: Choose audio retention from no-save through Forever; copy required recording before expiry.
outcome: Retained local audio remains available for future processing.
gaps: Temporary recovery is bounded; deletion leaves text but removes repair input; on-device storage alone is not a backup.

title: Dictate into another app and recover failed insertion
steps: Enable Dictation; choose shortcut/mic/provider; hold-release or toggle; if insertion fails choose Copy last dictation and paste.
outcome: Speech enters focused accessible text field.
gaps: Five-minute cap; paused during meetings; last result is in memory until disable/quit; CLI/MCP do not start dictation.

title: Query history through the CLI
steps: Install bundled CLI or build source; run doctor; query meetings; read bounded transcript pages or export complete record with JSON output.
outcome: Scripts access local meeting data with explicit source/path options.
gaps: GUI initializes DB; local and cloud differ; no XDG compliance established.

title: Connect an agent and review staged edits
platform: Local stdio MCP; optional hosted OAuth
steps: Connect local MCP or explicitly enable readable Cloud API snapshots; list/read context; stage local memo/summary proposal; review/apply in desktop.
outcome: Agent context and edits have source and review boundaries.
gaps: Hosted MCP read-only; readable cloud snapshots are separate from encrypted sync; no arbitrary desktop control.

title: Subscribe to signed meeting events
steps: Add HTTPS endpoint in Developers→Webhooks; save secret; test; receive completed/enhanced events; verify signature and deduplicate.
outcome: External automation receives meeting payloads.
gaps: App must run; closed-app events dropped; retries limited; delivery not tested.

title: Automate follow-up and Markdown vault export
steps: Choose starter or build trigger/actions; configure destination; review preview; Save & enable; inspect last run and retry failures.
outcome: Meetings produce local Markdown or connected-service updates.
gaps: App must run; no closed-app queue/backfill for Drive; unrelated-file collisions rejected; exported content can be overwritten on regeneration.

title: Capture and recover a mobile beta note
steps: Use Start listening or create a note; review/edit memo and outputs; retry transcription/summary when needed; allow background sync to finish.
outcome: Mobile conversation and edits can join the note library.
gaps: Source/release-note evidence only; not device-tested; mobile0.1.5 needs compatible sync versions and iOS background time is bounded.

title: Record on Watch and transfer after phone acknowledgement
steps: Grant mic; start/stop local recording; queue file through WatchConnectivity; retain pending entry until phone import acknowledgement.
outcome: Source implements recording plus acknowledged handoff.
gaps: No public shipped watch release established; deletes watch file after acknowledgement; crash durability and duplicate-import behavior untested.

title: Install Open and choose a graph
steps: Install the appropriate Open app; create or select a graph in the app iCloud container, or choose a self-managed folder where offered.
outcome: Markdown graph is the working library; no Reflect account required for core local notes.
gaps: Mac is free; official iOS/iPadOS access is subscription-backed. README beta/TestFlight wording lags live App Store distribution. Source pin is not release-binary validation.

title: Capture into a daily note
steps: Open the app to today; type ideas, journal entries or tasks; revisit another date.
outcome: Date-addressed Markdown stays available outside the app.
gaps: Offline and external-edit convergence were not exercised; daily-note capture is not an immutable version history.

title: Connect people and ideas with wiki links
steps: Type [[ to choose or create a linked note; follow links and incoming backlinks.
outcome: Notes become navigable as a network of people, projects and topics.
gaps: Backlinks do not establish a visual graph canvas, folder parity or collaboration.

title: Recall through local search and optional semantic search
platform: macOS; semantic runtime on supported Apple Silicon Mac
steps: Use Command-K for lexical note/backlink/tag search; optionally enable local semantic indexing and download its model.
outcome: Lexical recall and optional on-device embeddings support discovery.
gaps: Semantic embeddings are unavailable on Intel Macs and iOS per privacy docs; first model download needs network, and relevance was not measured.

title: Review, schedule and complete tasks
platform: macOS / iOS surfaces; detailed source Mac
steps: Open Tasks; filter Current/Overdue/Upcoming or search; edit/select/schedule tasks; complete then archive or reveal completed items.
outcome: Tasks remain in note Markdown and can be revisited through archived filters.
gaps: Different task markers and ordinary checkboxes have different semantics; cross-device interaction parity was not tested.

title: Reuse file-based templates
steps: Create or edit a template in Settings or templates/; invoke palette or slash-menu insertion at the cursor.
outcome: Verbatim Markdown structure is inserted and templates travel with the graph.
gaps: No variable expansion or automatically seeded templates; template text is separate from AI prompts.

title: Turn a calendar event into linked meeting notes
steps: Enable Calendar; grant OS permission; choose calendars; select an event, edit its name/attendees and choose whether to create a backlinked meeting note.
outcome: Daily note links to meeting and person notes derived from the local calendar.
gaps: EventKit metadata capture does not capture meeting audio, join Zoom/Meet, or identify who is speaking. Current mobile parity is not established here.

title: Record and retain a desktop audio memo
steps: Configure an OpenAI or Google transcription provider; activate memo recording and grant microphone access; speak; stop.
outcome: Completed audio segments are saved in audio-memos/, then transcription becomes a linked note in the daily record.
gaps: Inspected recorder uses microphone only. Cloud transcription remains required in this path; unsaved current segment and capture failures are not an absolute no-loss guarantee.

title: Recover transcription or save failures
steps: For a failed local save use Retry or Discard; for pending transcription restore network/key access and reopen/refocus or foreground the app.
outcome: Saved audio can finish transcription later without re-recording; the capture queue does not silently move past a parked local-save error.
gaps: Discard is destructive to that failed capture. Deterministic provider rejection creates failure text; retry cannot recover audio never durably saved.

title: Start or stop an iPhone memo from system entry points
platform: iOS 16.4+ for App Intents; widget availability depends on OS
steps: Invoke a supported record widget, record-audio link or Siri/Shortcuts action; let the app resolve graph/provider prerequisites; stop from supported controls or Live Activity.
outcome: Native recording can continue independently of the WebView and later enter the graph.
gaps: Widget invocation may foreground the app; not evidence of an Apple Watch app, iOS keyboard or telephone-call recording.

title: Recover native staged audio after interruption
steps: Allow native recorder to finalize staged segments; after interruption or relaunch, reopen/foreground and allow orphan scan and graph ingestion.
outcome: Finished staged files are copied before deletion; session assembly waits for contiguous locally available parts.
gaps: An unfinished segment can be lost if its container was not finalized; source uses 20-minute rotation. Mobile behavior was not fault-injected.

title: Regenerate a memo from retained audio
platform: macOS / mobile graph files; advanced recovery
steps: Retain the audio; remove both its generated transcription note and daily backlink so reconciliation sees the session as pending; allow another pass.
outcome: A missing memo note can be regenerated from persisted session data.
gaps: This is source-described recovery, not a confirmed polished reprocess button. Per-part transcript cache may reuse old recognition; changing model, preserving edited versions and forcing fresh recognition are not established.

title: Configure and remove AI providers
steps: Add a provider/model and own API key in settings; validate it, choose defaults, later remove it when unwanted.
outcome: AI calls route directly to the configured provider and secrets reside in the OS keychain according to documentation.
gaps: Provider billing is separate. Audio transcription provider selection differs from chat; privacy and secret storage were not independently audited.

title: Use a custom compatible chat endpoint
platform: macOS / iOS source; release availability unverified
steps: Choose OpenAI-compatible provider; enter HTTP(S) base URL, model identifier and optional key; validate/configure and use chat.
outcome: Current source can route chat to a compatible local or remote endpoint.
gaps: Compatibility, tool calling and mobile network reachability require validation. This does not change the hard-coded OpenAI/Google transcription path or prove an end-to-end self-hosted voice stack.

title: Ask questions with linked note evidence
steps: Open Ask your notes/Chat, select a configured model and ask a question; inspect linked source notes.
outcome: An answer can be traced back to notes used as context.
gaps: Citation completeness and answer quality were not tested; provider context may include search snippets and note content except private-note exclusions.

title: Preview an AI rewrite before accepting it
steps: Select note text; invoke AI menu, choose built-in/saved/ad-hoc prompt; inspect streaming preview and Accept, Discard or Retry with optional model change.
outcome: User explicitly accepts replacement or insertion; saved prompts support repeated transformations.
gaps: Private notes disable the action; manual chat pasting is outside automated note privacy checks. Mobile parity unverified.

title: Mark sensitive notes private
platform: macOS / iOS note files; CLI guards
steps: Set private: true on a note; use normal local editing while chat tools, selection AI and CLI refuse or omit that note.
outcome: Provider-directed note access and supported CLI discovery exclude the private note.
gaps: Flag is not encryption and does not exclude own Git backups. Fresh audio/transcript can still go to providers even when today is private; pasted content cannot be automatically recognized.

title: Capture browser context into local notes
steps: Install Reflect Capture; explicitly capture a page/selection/screenshot and optionally its page text; app drains the local inbox.
outcome: Source URL and captured material become local graph context, with queueing while the app is unavailable.
gaps: Later metadata/image enrichment may contact the captured site. Optional X bookmark/like capture has separate defaults and does not prove every requested action succeeded.

title: Enable iCloud sync without discarding the local graph
steps: Choose an iCloud graph at onboarding, or move an existing graph through Settings; wait for verified copy and reopen the destination.
outcome: Files sync through the Reflect iCloud container and the old local graph remains a recovery copy.
gaps: iCloud and Git sync are mutually exclusive for a graph. Contributor builds need valid entitlements; sync is not an independent backup.

title: Review conflicting iCloud edits
steps: Edit on separated devices; reconnect; let safe merges converge; inspect Needs review when overlapping edits remain and choose/reconcile versions.
outcome: Both conflicting variants are retained in markers/archive before explicit resolution.
gaps: Archive is bounded to roughly 90 days/20 versions per note; binary conflicts keep sibling copies. Real two-device convergence was not tested.

title: Back up to GitHub or an owned Git remote
platform: macOS; mobile GitHub documented, generic SSH source contract desktop
steps: Connect GitHub in Backup settings or configure an SSH/local bare origin; open graph, edit, and inspect backup status or Back up now.
outcome: Graph content is committed and synchronized to the chosen repository.
gaps: Private notes are included. Source excludes runtime state; remote size limits and pending safety cases matter. Generic-host HTTPS documentation conflicts, so that route remains unqualified.

title: Restore a graph on another computer
steps: Clone the owned backup repository; open the resulting folder as a graph; rebuild index and allow remote adoption.
outcome: Plain-file history can restore notes without the original Reflect account or device.
gaps: Requires a complete usable backup including wanted audio/assets; rebuilding derived state and resolving conflicts were not exercised.

title: Read notes from scripts or coding agents
steps: Select graph with --graph, REFLECT_GRAPH or directory ancestry; use today/search/show/path with --json; optionally install per-graph agent guidance in Settings.
outcome: Scripts obtain stable data-only stdout and explicit exit codes without a running desktop app for file reads.
gaps: CLI is read-only and private-note guarded; search requires an app-built index and can report stale results. No native MCP or hook system established.

title: Navigate and capture from another app
steps: Copy a stable note link or invoke reflect:// navigation; use append, checkbox or task with a single-line payload for today; use CLI open to resolve a target.
outcome: Other apps can navigate notes or queue narrowly scoped daily captures.
gaps: Links resolve within the open graph, not arbitrary graphs; desktop navigation grammar is not the iOS surface. No arbitrary command execution is exposed.

title: Import a copy from Reflect Classic
steps: Export Classic to ZIP; choose its ZIP in Open import settings; inspect progress, cancellation/error or completion summary.
outcome: A local graph gains imported content while the homepage promises original Classic data remains unchanged.
gaps: Full attachment fidelity, cancellation boundary and duplicate handling were not tested. Classic subscription is separate and claiming a migration offer does not cancel it.

title: Schedule selective bot capture
steps: Connect calendar; choose auto-join scope or enable one upcoming event; apply inclusion/exclusion rules.
outcome: Bot attempts eligible scheduled meetings.
gaps: Conferencing link required; adding an email invite after start is insufficient; bot leaves an empty meeting after ten minutes.

title: Invite a bot to a live meeting
steps: Open Capture or Add Notetaker; enter meeting URL and language; start; admit the bot if required.
outcome: Participant bot supplies a meeting record.
gaps: Join delay and host policy can block capture; named-speaker/media features depend on this mode.

title: Capture from desktop device audio
steps: Click Take Notes, or choose it from a detected-call prompt; use floating live pane; finish.
outcome: Transcript and summary appear in the library.
gaps: No saved audio/video and only generic speaker labels; switching to bot requires a separate session.

title: Disclose desktop capture
steps: At first use/update or in Recording settings select chat/audio notices; optionally choose Fireflies Watermark camera.
outcome: Participants can receive a capture signal.
gaps: Zoom/Meet chat posting uses Accessibility; audio notice depends on speaker/mic routing; signal delivery is untested.

title: Capture Meet from Chrome
steps: Install/sign in/authorize extension; choose auto-capture or start manually; stop and open Notebook.
outcome: Meeting audio and notes are saved without a participant bot.
gaps: Extension capture is Meet-only and audio-only; video needs bot; no desktop-mode retention assumptions.

title: Use live transcript and assistance
steps: Open Live Assist; inspect transcript/AI notes/prep; request catch-up, actions or a contextual answer; share according to access.
outcome: Live meeting context remains available during conversation.
gaps: Bot requirement varies by surface; named labels are mode-specific; dynamic prompts/queries may consume credits.

title: Write private notes and merge deliberately
steps: Switch to Manual Notes; type; leave private or enable Merge to summary; revisit after capture.
outcome: Personal notes autosave; selected content informs shared output.
gaps: Merged notes become visible to recap viewers; no immutable version history established.

title: Capture a relayed phone call
platform: Mac with iPhone / Windows with Phone Link
steps: Enable phone relay to computer; make or receive call through that route; use desktop Take Notes.
outcome: Call audio produces meeting text and summary.
gaps: No saved media in this mode; does not establish iOS-app PSTN origination or native phone-call interception.

title: Record an in-person mobile conversation
steps: Tap Record; add title or skip; pause/resume; stop; inspect status and Notebook.
outcome: Phone-microphone audio becomes a meeting.
gaps: No other-app call audio or Watch capture established; processing requires network.

title: Recover an offline mobile recording
steps: Record offline; open Profile > Local Recordings; reconnect; choose Upload, title and language; track status.
outcome: Queued audio reaches transcription when online.
gaps: No device-loss protection or documented indefinite post-upload device retention.

title: Import existing audio or video
steps: Upload supported file; set meeting information/language; monitor processing; open Uploads or timeline.
outcome: Existing source produces transcript and insights.
gaps: 150-minute duration limit; format/size quotas apply; no speech yields no transcript and short files may lack recaps.

title: Review, edit and clip evidence
steps: Open meeting; compare summary and transcript; search/edit text; play available media; select text to create a soundbite.
outcome: Evidence and derived notes can be checked and shared.
gaps: Playback needs retained media; undo/redo does not establish durable version history.

title: Correct speaker identities
steps: Rename one occurrence or all matching labels; split mixed-speaker paragraphs; save and regenerate notes.
outcome: Transcript and subsequent summary use corrected identities.
gaps: Source audio stays unchanged; overlap and initial identity mechanism remain unresolved.

title: Find and organize meeting history
steps: Search/filter by participant/date/capture source; choose channel; move or remove meetings; manage channel membership.
outcome: Related meetings form a reusable context set.
gaps: Removing/deleting a channel preserves meetings; deleting a meeting is different and permanent.

title: Ask about one processed meeting
steps: Open processed meeting; select AskFred; ask a question and follow up.
outcome: Answer uses that meeting context.
gaps: Paid-meeting chat credit behavior differs from live/global chat; current guide removes model picker here.

title: Ask across history and added context
steps: Choose meeting/person/group context; attach files or dictate/edit prompt; select offered model; submit.
outcome: Cross-meeting synthesis uses selected context.
gaps: Model/default names drift within docs; hosted model menu does not establish BYOK or local inference.

title: Create reusable AI processing
steps: Choose template or create custom instructions; enable skill; inspect Active Skills and output Feed.
outcome: Repeated meetings generate structured outputs.
gaps: Role controls and AI credit costs apply; not evidence of local hooks or portable skills files.

title: Connect tools and act from AskFred
steps: Add remote server; choose OAuth/API authentication; authorize; enable permitted tools; request an external action.
outcome: Meeting context can create or update downstream work.
gaps: Connector authorization and permissions are documented; universal per-action confirmation, undo and idempotency are not.

title: Use meetings through external MCP clients
steps: Configure Fireflies hosted MCP; authenticate; search/fetch authorized meetings or invoke available actions.
outcome: Other agents consume meeting context and can perform supported writes.
gaps: Not read-only: catalogue includes sharing and soundbite creation; some search tools are experimental.

title: Build an API integration
steps: Obtain API key; submit GraphQL queries; for live use discover meeting ID and subscribe to realtime updates.
outcome: Structured meeting records or timed transcript segments feed another tool.
gaps: No live request tested; repeated chunk IDs indicate updates; output speaker names do not reveal attribution mechanism.

title: React to meeting lifecycle webhooks
steps: Configure V2 URL, selected events and signing secret; verify incoming signature; fetch ready transcript/summary.
outcome: Bot-joined/transcribed/summarized events trigger workflows.
gaps: Owned-meeting scope; finite transient retries; a connected receiver response timeout is not retried; team scope is Enterprise/Super Admin.

title: Set up and dictate into other apps
steps: Choose language/mic/shortcut; grant permissions; practice; hold shortcut or double-tap; speak and finish in target field.
outcome: Formatted text enters the active app.
gaps: Mac needs Accessibility; mobile Talk is coming soon; formatting quality untested.

title: Recover failed text insertion
steps: When insertion fails, paste clipboard text or copy Not pasted entry from Dictation history; repair shortcut/mic selection.
outcome: Recognized text remains recoverable for another paste.
gaps: Clipboard/history is text recovery, not retained original audio; AirPods and Fn conflicts are documented.

title: Control dictation context and history
steps: Toggle optional Screen context; copy/delete individual history or clear it from settings; revoke OS permissions when needed.
outcome: User controls contextual processing and local text history.
gaps: Context sends audio/screen information to vendor/providers; raw dictation audio is discarded after processing.

title: Reprocess a meeting language
steps: Open language selector; choose language; confirm Reprocess; refresh; regenerate summary separately if stale.
outcome: A replacement transcript/summary is produced.
gaps: Maximum three retranscriptions; existing manual transcript edits are lost; no-bot session eligibility unspecified.

title: Export text and media
steps: Open processed meeting Download; choose transcript/summary/media and format/timestamps/speakers; save.
outcome: Portable artifacts leave the vendor library.
gaps: Media options exist only when captured; export is not automatic local retention.

title: Delete owned meetings
steps: Select meeting(s) or Notepad menu; choose Delete and confirm.
outcome: Meeting and associated stored content are removed.
gaps: Documented as permanent with no restore; external downloaded/shared copies are outside this flow.

title: Set future-meeting retention
steps: Enable auto-delete; choose interval; admin may enforce team choice.
outcome: Future meetings expire under the owner/team policy.
gaps: Focused guide says not retroactive; policy can remove originals and outputs.

title: Select private storage or BYOS
steps: Configure private storage with vendor; enable for new meetings; coordinate BYOS/location changes.
outcome: Meeting data is stored in the configured private bucket.
gaps: Processing remains on Fireflies servers in the US; location/setup wording varies; not full self-hosting.

title: Automate routing and access policy
steps: Create rule; combine title/host/participant/type filters; choose route/share/privacy/retention/language actions; test and inspect logs.
outcome: Matching meetings receive consistent downstream policy.
gaps: These are cloud policies, not XDG dotfiles; rollback/exactly-once execution unknown.
